Source Monster

Monster: Baby Basarios | CR: 1 | Tier: 1

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can speak this weapon's command word to gain a +2 bonus to your AC until the end of your next turn. Once used, you can't use this property again until you finish a long rest.

Armor Effect

(Spellcaster only) You know the @spell[shield] spell while you wear this armor. If you prepare spells, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If this spell is not on your class list, the spell is nonetheless a class spell for you.

Tags: mechanic:ac, mechanic:long-rest, type:defensive, class:spellcaster, mechanic:spell:lvl1-2
